ActorTalk: That year's graduation assessment was a ground-based practical combat exercise, but there was an accident. Apparently, there were quite a few casualties—it was one of the most devastating incidents in F.O.S.'s history. That was also the incident that caused all practicals to be cancelled.
Was that Gray Raven Commandant and Senior Vanessa's cohort?

That's right. Gray Raven Commandant was initially listed as missing, but miraculously survived in the end. Though, according to my connections at Star of Life, the commandant suffered from traumatic brain injuries and has partial memory loss.

Just surviving that is a feat in and of itself. I've seen parts of the simulation exam question banks before, and I heard they're all based on real battles that actually happened. If you put me in those situations, I'd never make it out alive.
Besides the Gray Raven Commandant, are there other seniors who were students in that class?
They just got lucky—somehow got hold of oral testimony records from an eyewitness who was present at the Night of F.O.S. Apparently they also claimed that the incident was connected to M.I.N.D.?

There are also Senior Vanessa, Senior Simon, and Senior Harley Jo, who are also survivors of that practical combat exercise. They're all in Task Forces now, and each of them has a distinguished record.

Speaking of... I heard that originally, Senior Harley Jo didn't actually pre-apply for a combat commander position in the military. But then he changed his application after he came back from the graduation assessment.
